results.summary: This franchise agreement grants the franchisee the right to operate an AIRSOPURE air cleaning products center in an exclusive territory. The franchisee must pay a $25,000 initial fee (partially refundable only if no site is found), ongoing royalties of 5% of gross sales, and advertising fees totaling 4% of gross sales. The franchisee must attend training, operate per the Operations Manual, purchase products from Airsopure, maintain insurance, and keep detailed records. Airsopure provides training, a manual, and consultation. Risks include no profit guarantees, strict termination rights for defaults (e.g., bankruptcy, false reports, failure to open), a 2-year post-termination non-compete within 25 miles, personal guarantee requirements, mandatory Texas venue for disputes, and potential liability for underpayment penalties plus audit costs. Renewal requires signing a new agreement and a general release.
